digest.component_or_area: tracker-footprint command and store measurement module
propositions: Provide an explicit opt-in read-only command to measure and report footprint layers separately: packed object bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, Git-directory bytes, and whole-clone totals

Distinguish between mounted tracker measurement (which may share objects with linked worktrees) and fresh-clone measurement (which resolves remote and creates a temporary unfiltered single-branch clone with hardlink optimization disabled)
Report platform-supported block allocation accounting (st_blocks) as structured unavailable values rather than fabricated zeros when not available
Ensure the footprint report identifies the measured ref/tip, provides schema-validated JSON and text output, and never triggers exit failures, workflow gates, or alerts based on size alone
